identity.name: RM-014: From HoReCa to IT Operations — A Gardener's Personal Transition
identity.description: Two-track strategic roadmap. Track A: crisis job search (May 2026, any remote 80k+ RUB). Track B: strategic transition to IT Operations Manager (June 2026+, 120k+ RUB). Ultimate goal: location-independent lifestyle with trial relocation to Vietnam.

meta.purpose: Two-track survival-to-strategy roadmap. Track A secures income within 30 days. Track B builds long-term IT career. Courses run in parallel.

context_for_sr.who: Voodoo (Dima), Gardener and co-creator of Mandala Symbiosis. 8+ years managing multi-location coffee business in Russia.
context_for_sr.situation: Current employer failing. Hard deadline: May 31, 2026 to find new income source.
context_for_sr.strategy: Two parallel tracks. Track A: any remote 80k+ RUB immediately. Track B: IT Operations Manager 120k+ RUB from June 2026.
context_for_sr.mandala_lever: Mandala project is portfolio proof of IT competence — architecting systems, using PM tools, full development lifecycle.
context_for_sr.courses_parallel: Google PM Certificate + COO OTUS start immediately. Do not wait for Track A completion. Progress during gaps between applications.

track_a.name: Track A: Crisis Job Search
track_a.goal: Any remote job with 80 000+ RUB income
track_a.reasoning: 30 days is too short for IT industry entry. Leverage 8-year HoReCa operations experience. Target: operations, administration, Chief of Staff in any sector.

m1_packaging.name: Packaging (May 1-7)
tasks: Experience audit + IT translation — deadline 02.05
Resume on hh.ru, Superjob, Rabota.ru, Zarplata.ru, Avito, TrudVsem — deadline 05.05
LinkedIn + Habr Career profiles — deadline 07.05
Geekjob + Getmatch + 10 Telegram channels — deadline 08.05

m2_first_wave.name: First Wave (May 8-14)
tasks: 70+ applications across all platforms — deadline 14.05
Employer verification via Dream Job — deadline 14.05

m3_interviews.name: Interviews (May 15-21)
tasks: All first-wave interviews — deadline 21.05
Second wave 20-30 applications + pitch calibration — deadline 21.05

m4_offer.name: Offer (May 22-31)
tasks: Minimum 1 written offer 80 000+ RUB (or expand to projects/contracts) — deadline 31.05

track_b.name: Track B: Strategic IT Transition
track_b.goal: Remote Operations Manager in IT, 120 000+ RUB
track_b.reasoning: After Track A income stabilised. Leverage Mandala portfolio + ongoing certifications + 8-year operations experience translated to IT context.

phase_1.name: Foundation (June-July 2026)
tasks: Continue Google PM Certificate (started May) — first 2 modules complete
Continue COO OTUS (started May) — in progress, 4-month program
Weekly Mandala devlog — public IT project timeline
Business English 2-3 sessions/week
Re-audit experience into IT language v2

phase_2.name: Packaging (August-September 2026)
tasks: Professional Mandala GitHub README (English)
LinkedIn optimized for IT Operations Manager
Start Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt certification
IT-focused resume v2

phase_3.name: Active Search (October-November 2026)
tasks: Active applications on hh.ru, Habr Career, Superjob, Geekjob, Getmatch
Networking via TenChat, 'Setka' (HH), LinkedIn
Employer due diligence via Dream Job
Target: offer 120 000+ RUB as IT Operations Manager

phase_4.name: Relocation Trial (December 2026+)
tasks: Visa, housing, logistics for 1-2 months in Vietnam
Stable remote work routine from new location
Continue Mandala development + devlog
Conscious decision: extend / return / next country

courses.strategy: Start immediately in May, progress in gaps between Track A applications. Complete by Track B Phase 2-3.

success_metrics.track_a: Written job offer 80 000+ RUB by May 31, 2026
success_metrics.track_b: IT Operations Manager offer 120 000+ RUB by December 2026
success_metrics.courses: Google PM Certificate and COO OTUS in progress by end of May 2026
success_metrics.relocation: 1+ month successful remote work from Vietnam

health.notes: v2.0.0: Major restructure. Split into two tracks (A: crisis, B: strategic). Track A deadline May 31. Courses run parallel. Bot roadmap '🚨 Crisis Job Search' created with 10 tasks.
